description.value: Gobong Korean Hotpot is a Korean restaurant in North Vancouver specialising in hotpot, a communal table-cooking style where diners simmer meat, vegetables, and other ingredients in a shared broth. The restaurant is fully indoor with a no-smoking policy, offering a warm and social dining experience. It would make a satisfying stop for cyclists looking for a substantial, warming meal after a ride on the North Shore.
